exposure: Discontinuation of Imatinib mesylate chemotherapy during pregnancy
cohort: A 28-year-old pregnant female at 34.2 weeks of gestation with a history of two previous cesarean sections and chronic myeloid leukemia (CML), who opted to discontinue chemotherapy during pregnancy.
finding: A 28-year-old pregnant female with CML, who discontinued Imatinib mesylate during pregnancy, presented in preterm labor with accelerated phase CML and placental abruption, ultimately succumbing to tumor lysis syndrome following an emergency cesarean section.
mod_finding: Following an emergency cesarean section, the patient developed disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC) and ultimately succumbed to tumor lysis syndrome.
